cards.claim: Initially reducing image size during training increases training efficiency
cards.conditions: Pre-trained ResNet models (ResNet18, 34, 50) trained on small datasets (steel microstructures, bee images, geographic aerial images) with free cloud GPU, comparing three training regimes: not increasing size, gradually increasing, or increasing in one step
cards.effect: Consistently increases training efficiency across datasets and network architectures

cards.effect: Reduces initial network parameters and total inference time
cards.evidence: Mechanistic hypothesis from regularization theory framework
